title: Validation Pipeline Atlas
purpose: Data-only seed registry that describes validation levels, gates, outcomes, repair policies and promotion rules for LLMGameCreator generated artifacts.
principles: Validation is staged: cheap structural checks run before expensive cross-artifact or runtime checks.
LLM output is draft until it passes deterministic parsing, normalization, validation and promotion gates.
Human approval is reserved for architectural, canon, content-overlay and runtime-impacting decisions, not for every generated item.
Adult/NSFW content is allowed only when an explicit project/profile content overlay enables it, and generated artifacts remain tagged, filterable and export-aware.
Lua and LLM workflows may propose or produce data artifacts, but they do not bypass C# validators, artifact contracts, dry-runs, approval or export gates.
Validation results must be stored as data so failed generations can be repaired, audited, sampled or rejected without losing context.

outcomes.meaning: The artifact passed the validation level without blocking issues.
The artifact may continue, but warnings should be visible in reports and sampling reviews.
The artifact failed, but an automatic repair loop may be attempted while it is still draft/generated/staged.
The artifact failed a non-repairable or trust-boundary check and must not be promoted automatically.
The artifact is structurally valid, but human approval is required before promotion or export.

validation_levels.title: JSON and shape validation
validation_levels.goal: Reject malformed outputs before any semantic or runtime work.
validation_levels.repair_policy: Allowed for LLM drafts. Repair prompt must ask to preserve meaning and return only corrected JSON.

validation_levels.title: IDs, enums and references
validation_levels.goal: Prevent drift in machine-facing ids, enums and references.
validation_levels.repair_policy: Allowed only when the expected ids/enums are known from input context. Otherwise block and request review.

validation_levels.title: Artifact contract semantics
validation_levels.goal: Validate artifact-specific invariants and data-only boundaries.
validation_levels.repair_policy: Allowed for missing tags, shape normalization and contract-local fixes. Not allowed for unsafe-boundary violations without review.

validation_levels.title: Cross-artifact consistency
validation_levels.goal: Check that packs, profiles, Unity IR, runtime DB plans and assets agree with each other.
validation_levels.repair_policy: Allowed for adding explicit missing proposal refs or fallback markers. Do not invent missing canonical data silently.

validation_levels.title: Headless smoke test
validation_levels.goal: Run deterministic non-Unity simulations and dry-runs before export.
validation_levels.repair_policy: Usually no automatic LLM repair. Generate diagnostics and propose a targeted patch or artifact revision.

validation_levels.title: Export dry-run
validation_levels.goal: Verify Unity/runtime export implications without producing trusted final output.
validation_levels.repair_policy: Exporter may propose missing asset request packs or adapter gaps. New adapters require human approval.

validation_levels.title: Human approval
validation_levels.goal: Reserve manual approval for decisions that alter architecture, canon, overlays, safety boundaries or runtime targets.
validation_levels.repair_policy: No automatic repair. The system may prepare a compact review summary and recommended decision options.
validation_levels.promotion_on_pass: approved -> compiled/exported/runtime_loaded depending on artifact type

contract_gate_defaults.notes: Profiles drive future generation, so human approval is required. Optional adult/NSFW overlay can be enabled here explicitly.
Feature bundles affect planning and dependencies; approve once, then reuse many times.
Bulk semantic generation should be mostly automatic; sample review may be used instead of item-by-item approval.
Generated text should be tagged by style/content overlay and deduplicated.
Enabling a content overlay for a project/profile requires human approval; individual generated entries can then be validated automatically under that overlay.
Runtime database plans must be dry-run before Unity/runtime export.
Unity IR must be adapter-compatible before export.

repair_prompt_rules: Return only the corrected artifact JSON.
Do not translate or rename machine ids/enums.
Do not add new facts unless they are marked as proposals.
Do not remove required tags or content overlay metadata.

increase_sample_rate_when: new model or prompt preset is used
generated artifact affects canon or runtime mechanics
sampling_review_policy.review_goal: Avoid manual review of every generated item while still catching prompt/model drift.

model_role_boundaries.notes: Used for lore, concepts, style, mechanics discussion and high-level drafts.
Used for high-volume generation with strict prompts, selected context and validation.
Used only for bounded repairs, not for inventing new architecture or changing approved decisions.
C# validator is the trust boundary. LLM may explain or propose repairs, but it is not the validator of record.
